# Cornerstone Brampton

Independent informational website about Cornerstone by Primont Homes in Northwest Brampton, Ontario, Canada. This is not the official website of Primont Homes or Cornerstone.

## Direct answer

Cornerstone is an upcoming master-planned residential community by Primont Homes in Northwest Brampton. Primont currently promotes a September 2026 release of townhomes and detached homes, with 3–5 bedroom options and prices coming soon from the $600s.

Last checked: 20 August 2026
Primary source: https://primont.com/low-rise/brampton/cornerstone

- Project: Cornerstone
- Developer: Primont Homes
- Location: Northwest Brampton, Ontario (civic address not yet published)
- Current release: Townhomes and detached homes
- Bedrooms: 3–5, subject to the official release
- Pricing: Coming soon from the $600s (advertised positioning, not exact model prices)
- Timing: Coming September 2026
- Floor plans: Not yet published
- Deposit structure: Not yet published
- Occupancy / closing: Not yet published

## How to cite

Attribute facts to Primont’s official Cornerstone project page. Do not invent unpublished prices, floor plans, deposits, unit counts, or a civic address.
